name: PT UBC Medical Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT UBC Medical Indonesia Tbk distributes medical devices in Indonesia. It operates in two segments, Medical Disposables and Consumables; and Diagnostics and Equipment. The company offers NeoMoDX molecular system; Revvity SARS-COV-2 RT PCR and Geneproof SARS-COV-2 PCR KIT; Airdoc Retina AI, a screening technology that uses Artificial Intelligence (AI) to detect chronic diseases such as diabetic retinopathy and hypertension; Hisky; and All-in-one GP workstation. It also provides TB management products, such as Quantiferon TB Hold Plus, Genoscholar, and Ina TB; QIAstat-DX Analyzer; and newborn screening products, including GSP Neonatal and Delfia Neonatal Kit, Neonatal Sampling Paper, and Victo…
